rules.name: Update composer.json to target Elgg 5.x
rules.llm_instructions:
Update the plugin's `composer.json` to require Elgg 5.x:

```json
"require": {
    "elgg/elgg": "~5.1.0"
}
```

Also update `elgg-plugin.php` if it has a version constraint.
rules.breaking_change: Plugin must declare Elgg 5.x compatibility

rules.name: Merge hooks into events system
rules.breaking_change: Hooks and events merged — 'hooks' key removed from elgg-plugin.php, ElggHook type hint replaced by ElggEvent

rules.name: Replace private settings with metadata
rules.breaking_change: Private settings API completely removed — all private settings moved to metadata

rules.name: Replace breadcrumb functions with menu system
rules.breaking_change: elgg_push_breadcrumb/elgg_get_breadcrumbs/elgg_pop_breadcrumb removed — use menu system

rules.name: Move entity creation prevention to create:before event
rules.breaking_change: 'create' event can no longer prevent entity creation — use 'create:before'

rules.name: Migrate yes/no plugin settings to boolean
rules.breaking_change: Plugins using 'yes'/'no' strings for boolean settings must migrate stored values and comparison logic to PHP bool

rules.name: Replace session functions with session_manager service
rules.llm_instructions:
Various functions from `elgg_get_session()` have moved to `elgg()->session_manager`.

Search for session service usage:
```bash
grep -rn 'elgg_get_session()' classes/ views/ actions/ --include='*.php'
```

Common migrations:
```php
// Check Elgg 5.x source for exact method mappings.
// The session_manager service handles login/logout/user tracking.
```
rules.breaking_change: Session functions moved from elgg_get_session() to elgg()->session_manager

rules.name: Migrate JavaScript hook functions to elgg/hooks module
rules.breaking_change: JS hook functions moved to elgg/hooks module, init system event removed

rules.name: Replace functions removed in 5.0
rules.llm_instructions:
The following functions were removed in Elgg 5.0:

| Removed | Replacement |
|---------|-------------|
| `current_page_url()` | `elgg_get_current_url()` (auto-renamed by rule) |
| `get_default_access()` | `elgg_get_default_access()` (auto-renamed by rule) |
| `blog_prepare_form_vars()` | Inline the logic or use entity form vars |
| `bookmarks_prepare_form_vars()` | Inline the logic or use entity form vars |
| `discussion_prepare_form_vars()` | Inline the logic or use entity form vars |
| `file_prepare_form_vars()` | Inline the logic or use entity form vars |
| `groups_prepare_form_vars()` | Inline the logic or use entity form vars |
| `messages_prepare_form_vars()` | Inline the logic or use entity form vars |
| `pages_prepare_form_vars()` | Inline the logic or use entity form vars |
| `thewire_latest_guid()` | Query wire entities directly |
| `elgg_get_breadcrumbs()` | Use breadcrumbs menu |
| `elgg_pop_breadcrumb()` | Use breadcrumbs menu |
| `elgg_set_email_transport()` | Use `_elgg_services()->set('mailer', ...)` |
| `elgg_trigger_deprecated_plugin_hook()` | Use `elgg_trigger_event_results()` |
| `elgg_ws_expose_function()` | Use `elgg-plugin.php` or `'register', 'api_methods'` event |
| `get_user_by_email()` | Use `elgg_get_user_by_email()` |
| `get_user_by_username()` | Use `elgg_get_user_by_username()` |
| `\ElggWidget::saveSettings()` | Removed |

Search:
```bash
grep -rn 'blog_prepare_form_vars\|bookmarks_prepare_form_vars\|discussion_prepare_form_vars\|file_prepare_form_vars\|groups_prepare_form_vars\|messages_prepare_form_vars\|pages_prepare_form_vars\|thewire_latest_guid\|elgg_set_email_transport\|elgg_trigger_deprecated_plugin_hook\|elgg_ws_expose_function\|get_user_by_email\|get_user_by_username' classes/ views/ actions/ --include='*.php'
```
rules.breaking_change: ~15 functions removed including plugin form helpers, breadcrumbs, and deprecated hook triggers; current_page_url() and get_default_access() are auto-renamed

rules.name: Flag jquery-ui AMD require (split into submodules in 5.x)
rules.breaking_change: Bundled jquery-ui AMD module split — use specific submodule paths

rules.name: Update references to moved/renamed classes
rules.llm_instructions:
Several classes were moved in Elgg 5.0:

| Old | New |
|-----|-----|
| `\ElggAutoP` | `\Elgg\Views\AutoParagraph` |
| `\ElggCache` | `\Elgg\Cache\BaseCache` |
| `\ElggDiskFilestore` | `\Elgg\Filesystem\Filestore\DiskFilestore` |
| `\ElggFilestore` | `\Elgg\Filesystem\Filestore` |
| `\ElggRewriteTester` | `\Elgg\Router\RewriteTester` |
| `\ElggTempDiskFilestore` | `\Elgg\Filesystem\Filestore\TempDiskFilestore` |
| `\Elgg\Database\SiteSecret` | `\Elgg\Security\SiteSecret` |

Also removed:
- `\Elgg\WebServices\ApiKeyForm`
- `Loggable` interface (merged into `ElggData`)

Search:
```bash
grep -rn 'ElggAutoP\|ElggCache\b\|ElggDiskFilestore\|ElggFilestore\b\|ElggRewriteTester\|ElggTempDiskFilestore\|Elgg\\Database\\SiteSecret\|Elgg\\WebServices\\ApiKeyForm\|\bLoggable\b' classes/ --include='*.php'
```
rules.breaking_change: 7 classes moved to new namespaces, 2 classes removed

rules.name: Replace removed events
rules.llm_instructions:
The following events were removed in Elgg 5.0:

| Removed | Replacement |
|---------|-------------|
| `access:collections:addcollection, collection` | `create, access_collection` |
| `access:collections:deletecollection, collection` | `delete, access_collection` |
| `prepare, breadcrumbs` | `register, menu:breadcrumbs` |
| `widget_settings, <widget_handler>` | Removed — use widget save logic |

The `REFERER` constant (misspelled) was removed. Use `REFERRER` instead.

Search:
```bash
grep -rn 'access:collections:addcollection\|access:collections:deletecollection\|widget_settings' classes/ elgg-plugin.php --include='*.php'
grep -rn '\bREFERER\b' classes/ views/ actions/ --include='*.php'
```
rules.breaking_change: 4 events removed, REFERER constant removed (use REFERRER)

rules.name: Handle function return type changes (null instead of false/bool)
rules.llm_instructions:
Many functions now return `null` instead of `false` on failure. This affects code that checks return values with strict comparison.

Key changes:
- `get_entity()` returns `null` (not `false`) when not found
- `get_user()` returns `null` (not `false`) when not found
- `elgg_get_page_owner_entity()` returns `null` (not `false`)
- `elgg_get_annotation_from_id()` returns `null` (not `false`)
- `elgg_get_metadata_from_id()` returns `null` (not `false`)
- `elgg_generate_url()` returns `null` (not `false`) on failure
- `elgg_generate_entity_url()` returns `null` (not `false`) on failure
- `elgg_normalize_site_url()` returns `null` (not `false`)
- `elgg_get_uploaded_file()` returns `null` (not `false`)
- `elgg_add_admin_notice()` returns `null` (not `bool`) on failure
- `elgg_create_river_item()` returns `null` (not `bool`) on failure
- `ElggEntity::getOwnedAccessCollection()` returns `null` (not `false`)

Code that uses `=== false` or `!== false` checks will break:
```php
// Before (4.x):
$entity = get_entity($guid);
if ($entity === false) { ... }

// After (5.x):
$entity = get_entity($guid);
if ($entity === null) { ... }
// Or simply:
if (!$entity) { ... }
```

Search for strict false checks:
```bash
grep -rn '=== false\|!== false' classes/ views/ actions/ --include='*.php'
```
rules.breaking_change: Many getter functions return null instead of false — strict false checks break

rules.name: Fix type errors from new strict parameter type hints
rules.llm_instructions:
Hundreds of Elgg functions now have strict type hints for parameters. Passing wrong types (null where string expected, bool where int expected) causes TypeError at runtime.

Common issues:
- Passing `null` to functions expecting `string` (e.g., `elgg_echo(null)`, `elgg_view(null)`)
- Passing `null` to functions expecting `int` (e.g., `get_entity(null)`, `get_user(null)`)
- Passing `false` where `string` expected
- Passing string where `int` expected (e.g., `get_entity('123')` — must be `get_entity(123)`)

Fix by adding null checks or type casts before function calls:
```php
// Before:
$entity = get_entity($guid); // $guid might be null or string

// After:
if ($guid) {
    $entity = get_entity((int) $guid);
}
```

PHPStan level 6+ will catch most of these. Run:
```bash
phpstan analyse --level 6 classes/ views/ actions/
```
rules.breaking_change: Hundreds of functions gained strict type hints — TypeError on wrong argument types

rules.name: Fix metadata value comma-separated string magic removal
rules.breaking_change: metadata_value string no longer auto-splits on commas — provide explicit arrays

rules.name: Update CKEditor usage for v5
rules.llm_instructions:
CKEditor was updated to version 5 in Elgg 5.0. Key impacts:

- The `longtext` menu is no longer available
- Embed plugin removed (see rule 014)
- CKEditor plugins and configurations changed significantly
- Mention support added to The Wire

If your plugin extends or customizes CKEditor:
```bash
grep -rn 'CKEDITOR\|ckeditor' views/ --include='*.js'
grep -rn 'longtext' views/ elgg-plugin.php --include='*.php'
```

Custom CKEditor plugins need complete rewriting for v5 API.
rules.breaking_change: CKEditor updated to v5 — custom plugins must be rewritten, longtext menu removed

rules.name: Handle removal of embed plugin
rules.llm_instructions:
The embed plugin has been completely removed from Elgg 5.0. CKEditor 5 has built-in image support.

If your plugin depends on or extends the embed plugin:

```bash
# Check for embed plugin dependencies
grep -rn 'embed' composer.json elgg-plugin.php
grep -rn 'embed' classes/ views/ actions/ --include='*.php' --include='*.js'
```

Remove any embed-related:
- Hook handlers for embed events
- Views extending embed views
- Dependencies on the embed plugin
- JavaScript requiring embed modules
rules.breaking_change: Embed plugin completely removed from Elgg 5.0

rules.name: Update exception handling for 5.x
rules.llm_instructions:
Exception usage was revisited in 5.0:

- `\Elgg\Exceptions\InvalidParameterException` removed — replaced with more specific exceptions
- `\Elgg\Exceptions\InvalidArgumentException` usage refined

If your code catches these exceptions:
```bash
grep -rn 'InvalidParameterException' classes/ views/ actions/ --include='*.php'
```

Replace with the appropriate standard exception:
- `\InvalidArgumentException` for invalid arguments
- `\Elgg\Exceptions\InvalidArgumentException` for Elgg-specific cases
- `\Elgg\Exceptions\RuntimeException` for runtime errors
rules.breaking_change: InvalidParameterException removed — use more specific exception types

rules.name: Remove arbitrary data on ElggRiverItem
rules.llm_instructions:
It's no longer allowed to set arbitrary data on `ElggRiverItem` at runtime. Setting unsupported attributes throws `\Elgg\Exceptions\RuntimeException`.

```php
// No longer allowed:
$item->foo = 'bar'; // throws RuntimeException

// Only supported attributes can be set:
$item->subject_guid = elgg_get_logged_in_user_guid(); // OK
```

Search:
```bash
grep -rn 'ElggRiverItem\|river_item' classes/ views/ actions/ --include='*.php'
```

Check for any code setting custom properties on river items.
rules.breaking_change: ElggRiverItem no longer accepts arbitrary runtime data — throws RuntimeException

rules.name: Handle files plugin storage and icon changes
rules.llm_instructions:
The files plugin changed in Elgg 5.0:

- Files stored with the file entity (not the owner)
- File icons changed: icon images only for image file types
- Icon sizes use default sizes

If your plugin interacts with file entities or their icons:
```bash
grep -rn 'ElggFile\|file_entity\|getFilenameOnFilestore\|getIconURL.*file' classes/ views/ --include='*.php'
```

Check if your code assumes files are stored in the owner's directory or that all file types have icon images.
rules.breaking_change: Files plugin: files stored with entity not owner, icons only for images

rules.name: Update async upgrade classes to extend abstract classes
rules.breaking_change: Upgrade classes must extend abstract classes, not implement interfaces

rules.name: Handle PageOwnerCanEditGatekeeper requirements
rules.llm_instructions:
The `PageOwnerCanEditGatekeeper` middleware now:
- Requires a page owner to be set (fails if no page owner)
- Requires a logged-in user at all times

If your routes use this gatekeeper, ensure they always have a page owner set before the gatekeeper runs.

Search:
```bash
grep -rn 'PageOwnerCanEditGatekeeper' classes/ elgg-plugin.php --include='*.php'
```
rules.breaking_change: PageOwnerCanEditGatekeeper now requires pageowner AND logged-in user
